title: Actor network clustering over the full record
definition: One row per actor cluster: its anchor actor, dominant country, size and leading members.
notes: Actor network clusters: 159 clusters and 361 bridge actors on the relationships recorded by the period's end. Largest: Iran network (IRN) (1,033 actors); Israel network (ISR) (705 actors); Israeli military network (ISR) (527 actors); United States network (USA) (456 actors); Saudi Arabia network (YEM) (445 actors); United States military network (USA) (431 actors).
